# Sample

You open the door and you stop. The hallway is quiet — too quiet. You know the sound your house makes at night, and this is not it.

He said, "Wait — not yet." You waited. You **know** it. You **do**.

**Nobody moves.**

This is the part where you decide. Your hand is on the door and your door is the only door that matters, and you know it, and you have known it for years, and this sentence runs long on purpose to trip the counter.

You close the door.
